independence_statement: I am the independently delegated read-only reviewer, distinct from translator sa-0-f0ec436b / deleg_9f946d3c. I read the complete actual canonical Arabic page and each complete target directly, comparing English against Arabic and Indonesian against Arabic separately. I did not draft, repair, or edit either target. Structural validation and the parent's frozen-reader rebuild were not treated as semantic evidence. I did not inspect neighboring pages, infer absent continuation, or invent a reviewer session identifier.

review_scope.method: Complete clause-by-clause independent source comparisons, with raw-byte hashing, exact embedded-source verification, and ordered opaque-run extraction performed by a read-only Python command.

byte_and_structure_evidence.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over raw file bytes, without normalization
byte_and_structure_evidence.embedding_test: Each target starts with Arabic:\n; the bytes before the target-language separator equal the entire canonical raw source followed by one wrapper newline. No source-byte normalization was used.
